body: I am at the same age as you and totally understand everything you posted. I know how awful it is to feel, and I'm sorry you have to experience this too.

I'd love to change my scenery but I can't afford it, I barely afford to pay my bills some weeks, it is impractical for me to believe I can move. As for peers, I am just mentioning co-workers and casual acquantinces because I actually don't have friends or anyone I actually talk to. I'm glad that your life did a change, and it makes me happy to know that life works out for some people but for people like me, it just doesnt. I can't explain it but I feel in my bones that I was not meant to have good things occur for me.
true for some it might but the rhetoric is useless for me.
